To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NaBFID to complete the application. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NaBFID Business Analyst recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the NaBFID Business Analyst recruitment is 25 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Business Analyst post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Company Secretary (Member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI)) with a graduation in any stream. This qualification can be completed before, alongside, or after the CS qualification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Business Analyst position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Business Analyst position is between 21 years (minimum) and 32 years (maximum). Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Business Analyst role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Business Analyst role will receive a salary of Rs. 14.50 lakh per annum.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Business Analyst post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Business Analyst post in the National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (NaBFID).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official website or the provided link.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the NaBFID Business Analyst recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Business Analyst position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Business Analyst position will primarily involve a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the NaBFID located?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for positions in Mumbai, as indicated by the location mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job for the Business Analyst position is on a contractual basis.
